learning_outcomes.text: Explanation and interpretation of the operating modes of static, electromechanical converters, electrical and electromechanical equipment.
Design of electromechanical or electrical installations.
Identification and selection of components for operation, maintenance and integration in electromechanical systems.
Acquiring basic knowledge of electrical installations, especially low voltage electrical installations.
Skills regarding reading and understanding a technical documentation, with the knowledge of the representation of equipment and apparatus in the diagrams of electrical installations.
Knowledge of energy characteristics of consumers.
Knowledge of the characteristics and role of equipment and apparatus in the structure of electrical installations at consumers.
Knowledge the structure of the different categories of electrical installations, of the variants of equipping the circuits, columns and supply points.
Knowledge the basics and measures taken to ensure the quality of electricity to consumers, reliable operation of installations and reduction of losses.
Skills regarding the sizing, choice and adjustment of equipment and apparatus in the structure of electrical installations.
Knowledge of protection measures against electric shocks, as a principle and as a method of implementation in electrical installations.

syllabus_topics: Installations for the production, transmission, distribution and use of electricity with the video-projector or smartboard and additional explanations on the board.
Basic processes related to the use of electricity
Electric power system
Effects of electric current on the elements of the electrical installation
Accidental contact of the elements of the electrical installation with the human body
Contact of the elements of the electrical installation with the ground
Electrical installations - basics
Categories of electrical installations
Elements of the installation - equipment and conductive paths
The structure of an installation. Electrical circuit - the basic unit of the installation
Technical documentation for an electrical installation
Quality conditions in the supply of electricity to consumers
Disturbances in the power supply network
Electricity quality indicators
Continuity in power supply
Transformer stations and substations
Transformer stations. Primary circuits, secondary circuits, own services and auxiliary installations
Determination of the number and power of transformers. Aspects of economic functioning
Medium voltage distribution
Transformer substations
Basics of protection by relays
Power supply of industrial equipment and receivers
Power system components
Consumer electrical distribution networks
Diagrams of low voltage electrical networks
Impedance of the supply path in radial networks and impedance of passive receivers
Electrical loads in networks
Power circulation in the alternating current network
Electrical calculation of loads. Principles for determining the required power
Coefficient of demand method
Calculation currents for common receiver circuits and for columns
Conductors used in electrical installations
Types of conductors in low voltage electrical installations
Symbolization of conductors and cables
Maximum permissible stresses for different types of conductors
Choice of conductor section
Switching and protection apparatus in electrical installations
Types of apparatus and their functions
Switching apparatus. Specific issues.
Protection of receivers and circuits in low voltage electrical installations. Protection of electrical columns. Conditions of provision.
Correlation of the characteristics of the devices in the low voltage network. Selectivity
Power factor compensation in industrial electrical installations.
Reactive power circulation. Power factor
Causes and effects of reactive power consumption
Methods for reducing reactive power flow
Sizing of capacitor banks and related equipment
Electric shock protection installations
Direct touch, indirect touch, step voltage
Protective measures against electric shock
Grounding installations - construction, sizing
Voltage loss in low voltage electrical networks
Low voltage power line - line impedance, equivalent wiring diagram and calculation diagram
Voltage drop, voltage loss, voltage deviation - definitions
Determination of voltage losses in lines with concentrated load, respectively with distributed load, without peak loads
The influence of peak loads on the calculation of voltage losses
Checking for voltage loss
Electrical installations related to buildings
Protective measures against electric shock, Part I
Protective measures against electric shock, Part II
Experimental determination of grounding resistance
Ensuring the supplementary power supply to consumers
Power factor compensation in industrial electrical installations
Electrical installations for buildings
Verification of knowledge and evaluation of activity at laboratory classes
assessment_rules: The final grade for laboratory activity (L) is calculated as (TL + DL) / 2, where TL >= 5 and DL >= 5. Passing the course requires Ex >= 5 and L >= 5. The final grade (N) is calculated as N = 0.75 * Ex + 0.25 * L.
